abstract.#text: "Exploring the development of mathematics historically and in the light of the various men who contributed to its understanding, Morris Kline in a highly specific way proceeds to show how, from a single point, man can understand the physical, chemical, astronomical, and geographic truths of his universe simply by employing the techniques of mathematical investigation." Kirkus.
